Franklin Memorial Library to hold monthly staff meetings
By thecrossroadsnews,
19 hours agoAs July comes to an end and August begins, school starts next week, and we would like to wish all the students in our community a happy first day of school! As you know, we host the Veterans Breakfast every Monday at 9:15 a.m. and Toddler Time every Friday at 10:30 a.m. We are open from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday-Friday and on Saturdays, we are open from 8 a.m. to 12 p.m. In the month of August, we will pick back up on our staff meetings each month with this upcoming one being held next Wednesday, August 6, at 4 p.m. Please take note of this new schedule as we will close one hour before our regular closing time for this meeting. We will hold a Children’s Craft August 7, at 3:30 p.m. and an Adult Craft Wednesday August 13, at 10:30 a.m. If you would like more up-date information, follow us on Facebook or to sign up for these upcoming crafts, call us at (478)237.7791 or visit us at 331 West Main Street, Swainsboro.
